main_body: patient bed (mattress with pillow and sheet and metal frame)
top_band: headboard top band rows 11-12 (light grey), and main mattress top surface rows 22-42 (white/light grey pillow, sheet, and blue blanket fold)
evidence: The bed shows both a clear horizontal top surface for the mattress/bedding (rows 22-42, with pillow at 23-26, folded sheet at 28-31, blue blanket at 33-36) and vertical front-facing structures: the headboard face (rows 13-21 with vertical bars inset) and the footboard/front frame face below the mattress (rows 43-47, stepping down from light grey to dark shadow at the base).

style.evidence: While the metal frame and bedding use a decent number of grey/blue steps (around 5 shades of grey and 4 blues), the piece relies on a straight, uniform near-black outer border down both sides and across the top/headboard slots, and geometric band shading rather than the organic pixel-level texture and dark-material-tone outlines of the Beodeul reference props.
